LanguageData.RMN.NotReady: Settings are available once the game has finished loading.
LanguageData.RMN.AppliesOnClose: Changes apply when you close this window. Nothing is recalculated while you drag sliders.
LanguageData.RMN.Presets.Intro: Pick a starting point, then tweak whatever you like in the other tabs. A preset replaces all of your current settings.
LanguageData.RMN.Preset.Vanilla.Desc: Everything exactly as the game ships it. Use this to start from scratch.
LanguageData.RMN.Preset.Light.Desc: Takes the edge off. Bad thoughts are about 20% weaker, grief and social grudges fade a bit sooner, base mood +5.
LanguageData.RMN.Preset.Reasonable.Desc: The original mod's idea. Bad thoughts are roughly halved and fade faster, breaks end sooner, base mood +10, beauty and comfort drain slower, berserk needs the psychopath trait, and battle focus is on.
LanguageData.RMN.Preset.Relaxed.Desc: For when you just want to build. Bad thoughts are about a third of vanilla, base mood +15, and colonists break at a lower mood.
LanguageData.RMN.Preset.Confirm: Replace all of your current settings with the {0} preset?
LanguageData.RMN.Summary: {0} thoughts found. {1} categories changed, {2} thoughts with their own override.
LanguageData.RMN.VanillaTips: Show vanilla values in thought tooltips
LanguageData.RMN.VanillaTipsTip: Adds a line like "Vanilla mood: -10" to the tooltip of any thought this mod changed.
LanguageData.RMN.Share.ImportConfirm: Replace all of your current settings with the ones on your clipboard?
LanguageData.RMN.Share.ImportedWithProblems: Settings pasted, but {0} line(s) were unreadable or out of range and were skipped or clamped.
LanguageData.RMN.Share.ThoughtListCopied: Copied {0} thoughts as a table. Paste it into a bug report if a thought is in the wrong category.
LanguageData.RMN.MoodNegativeTip: Scales negative mood effects. x0.5 turns a -10 into a -5. x0 removes them.
LanguageData.RMN.OpinionNegativeTip: Scales negative opinion effects, the ones that make pawns dislike each other.
LanguageData.RMN.DurationTip: Scales how long memories last. Thoughts that come and go with a situation (cold, darkness, an ugly room) are not affected.
LanguageData.RMN.Category.ApplyToAllConfirm: Copy the {0} sliders to every category? This overwrites all of them.
LanguageData.RMN.Bulk.ResetConfirm: Put all {0} shown thoughts back on their category settings?
LanguageData.RMN.Bulk.MuteConfirm: Mute all {0} shown thoughts? They will give no mood or opinion at all.
LanguageData.RMN.Thought.SelectHint: Click a thought to change it on its own.
LanguageData.RMN.Thought.IsMuted: Muted. This thought gives no mood or opinion and is hidden from the needs tab.
LanguageData.RMN.Breaks.Intro: When colonists snap and what happens when they do.
LanguageData.RMN.Breaks.ThresholdTip: Scales the mood at which pawns start having mental breaks. Lower means they hold out longer. Trait modifiers like Iron-willed still stack on top.
LanguageData.RMN.Breaks.StateDurationTip: Scales how long a mental break lasts once it starts.
LanguageData.RMN.Breaks.CommonalityTip: How often this break gets picked compared to the others. x0 means it never happens.
LanguageData.RMN.Needs.Intro: Base mood is where a colonist with no thoughts at all sits. The rates below control how fast drifting needs like mood, beauty and comfort catch up to where they are heading.
LanguageData.RMN.Needs.BaselineTip: Mood points added to every colonist's starting mood.
LanguageData.RMN.Needs.RiseTip: How fast this need climbs when things get better.
LanguageData.RMN.Needs.FallTip: How fast this need drops when things get worse.
LanguageData.RMN.Battle.Intro: Colonists who are drafted or were just in a fight ignore small bad memories from the categories you pick. Nobody cares that they ate without a table while raiders are at the door. Only checked when a memory is gained, never every tick.
LanguageData.RMN.Battle.MaxMoodTip: Bad memories this size or smaller are ignored in combat. Anything worse still lands.
LanguageData.RMN.Battle.WindowTip: How long after fighting a colonist still has battle focus. Drafted colonists always have it.
